results.name: Pokémon
results.overview: Join Ash accompanied by his partner Pikachu, as he travels through many regions, meets new friends and faces new challenges on his quest to become a Pokémon Master.

results.name: Pokémon Horizons
results.overview: Follow Liko and Roy as they unravel the mysteries that surround them and encounter Friede, Captain Pikachu, Amethio, and others during their exciting adventures!

results.title: Pokémon Detective Pikachu
results.overview: In a world where people collect pocket-size monsters (Pokémon) to do battle, a boy comes across an intelligent monster who seeks to be a detective.

results.name: Pokémon Evolutions
results.overview: Follow different Trainers around the Pokémon world as they grow and evolve with their Pokémon.

results.name: Pokémon: Twilight Wings
results.overview: This series focuses on the residents of the Galar Region. It is set to focus on their dreams, realities, challenges they must face and conflicts they must overcome. This is all linked through the Galar Taxi Driver.

results.name: Pokémon Concierge
results.original_name: ポケモンコンシェルジュ
results.overview: Welcome to Pokémon Resort, a peaceful getaway for Pokémon to relax and have fun. Which adorable guest will the new concierge Haru befriend and help first?

results.title: Pokémon the Movie 2000
results.original_title: 劇場版ポケットモンスター 幻のポケモン ルギア爆誕
results.overview: When Lawrence III's scheme to capture the Legendary Pokémon Lugia upsets the balance of nature, it is up to Ash Ketchum and his friends to save the world.

results.name: Pokémon: Hisuian Snow
results.overview: The story of a boy named Alec and his encounter with a Hisuian Zorua. When he was younger, Alec's father taught him that people and Pokémon cannot live together. But Alec's interactions with the Zorua might offer a different lesson.

results.name: Pokémon Generations
results.original_name: ポケモンジェネレーションズ
results.overview: The miniseries revisits each generation of the Pokémon video game series to shed new light on some timeless moments. From the earliest days in the Kanto region to the splendor of the Kalos region, go behind the scenes and witness Pokémon history with new eyes!

known_for.title: Arandel's Bach Evolution in the Grande Galerie de l'Évolution  - Paris Sur Mesure 2023
known_for.original_title: Arandel's Bach Evolution in the Grande Galerie de l'Évolution  - Paris Sur Mesure 2023
known_for.overview: French multi-instrumentalist Arandel returns to the music of Bach for Paris Sur Mesure with the help of a string quartet and dancers from the Lyon Opera Ballet and Pokemon Crew. A fusion of genres on display at the Grande Galerie de l'Evolution in Paris.

known_for.title: Lihat Boleh, Pegang Jangan
known_for.overview: Mr. Kimbul faces competition with Ms. Umi, two meatball stalls. They constantly competing with one another over crowds. Suddenly, a new meatball stall opens with a nice interior. Now they have to prepare to get back their customers.

results.title: The Story of Pokemon
results.overview: Gotta catch 'em all—the monsters and the facts! This doc explores the rich and storied past of the highest grossing media franchise of all time.

results.title: Pokémon: The First Movie
results.original_title: 劇場版ポケットモンスター ミュウツーの逆襲
results.overview: Determined to prove its superiority, a bio-engineered Pokémon called Mewtwo lures Ash, Pikachu and others into a Pokemon match like none before.

results.title: Pokémon 4Ever
results.original_title: 劇場版ポケットモンスター セレビィ 時を超えた遭遇
results.overview: In order to escape a greedy Pokémon hunter, Celebi must use the last of its energy to travel through time to the present day. Celebi brings along Sammy, a boy who had been trying to protect it. Along with Ash, Pikachu, and the rest of the gang, Sammy and Celebi must encounter an enemy far more advanced than the hunter, with the fate of the forest hanging in the balance.

known_for.title: Dê Uma Xanxa ao Amor
known_for.overview: In the story, this northeastern woman is personified by Xanxa, chubby and friendly, who without having much hope that her life will improve, will try her luck in the big city. It is in the urban environment that she meets Bob, aspiring actor, only child, rich boy, handsome, spoiled and loved by his father Cachorrão. These two characters Xanxa and Bob, with completely different lives and expectations, live a great love.

results.title: Pokémon Heroes
results.original_title: 劇場版ポケットモンスター 水の都の護神 ラティアスとラティオス
results.overview: Ash, Pikachu and the gang try and stop a pair of thieves hiding out in the canals and alleyways of Altomare, the age-old water capital. Joining the adventure are two new legendary Pokémon, a pair of siblings named Latias and Latios, who serve as peacekeepers and protectors of the Soul Dew — a priceless treasure with a mysterious power.

results.name: Pokémon: Paldean Winds
results.overview: Follow several academy students as they come into their own, growing and learning as they attend school.

known_for.title: Cinema for the Dead
known_for.overview: In the village of Barra Grande, among appearances and disappearances, the animals keep the dead company.

results.name: Pokemon no Uchi Atsumaru?
results.original_name: ポケモンの家あつまる？
results.overview: Japanese variety show about everything Pokémon.
